name: Halftone
author: Erin Carter
description: A rotated print-screen of crisp dots whose size swells and shrinks with a drifting tone field — fat where the light pools, fine where it thins, tinted across the palette left to right. Clean, graphic, high-contrast.

params.label: Dot count
params.effect: How many dots span the frame; low is bold and chunky, high is a fine screen.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: Drift speed of the tone field that swells the dots; 0 holds the pattern still.

params.label: Contrast
params.effect: How hard the dots clip on and off; high is sharp ink-on-paper, low is soft.

params.label: Screen angle
params.effect: Rotation of the dot screen, like a print halftone angle.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer swells the dots toward it; 0 ignores the mouse.
